crossRefs.note: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.
“ ‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the…
He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices…

translations.web: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.
